landing.heroTitle:
Redesign & Stage Your Home
in Seconds with AI
landing.heroSubtitle: AlgoreitAI’s unique power is generating "wow" designs that keep it real. We don't just create theoretical magazine photos—we suggest stunning transformations that preserve your home's layout and can be practically executed.
landing.trialText: No credit card required · Free beta access
landing.step1Text: Take a picture of your room, house, or garden.
landing.step2Text: Select from Modern, Minimalist, Industrial, and 30+ more.
landing.step3Text: Get unlimited realistic variations in seconds.
landing.feature1Text: We harness the world's most advanced AI technology but hide the complexity. You get a simple, intuitive tool that delivers professional-grade results for your home instantly.
landing.feature2Text: Unlike other tools that hallucinate impossible structures, our AI respects your home's actual layout. The results are realistic, practical, and truly achievable.
landing.feature3Text: Explore unlimited renovation and staging styles. From Scandinavian to Industrial, easily visualize thousands of potential futures for your space in seconds.

steps.1a: Optional: Upload a Floor Plan to define your rooms.
steps.1: Upload Photos and match each one to a room type (e.g., "Living Room") using the selector at the uploaded photos bottom.
steps.2: Click Room to select which photo to edit in the Working Area.
steps.3: Use Enhance Quality to improve photo resolution if needed.
steps.4: Use Renovate ▾ to update floors, walls, exterior, or garden.
steps.5: Use Furniture ▾ to clear the room or stage it with new furniture.
steps.6: Use Style ▾ to choose the design aesthetic (e.g., Modern, Farmhouse).
steps.7: Click ✨ AlgoreitAI to generate your renovation (after selecting Renovate/Furniture and Style options).
steps.8: All results appear in the "Renovation Photos" row—click them to chain more edits!

tipsList.1: Furniture First: Try removing furniture first to get a clean slate, then stage or renovate.
tipsList.2: Chaining: Every result is a new starting point. Click a result in the "Renovation Photos" row to keep editing it.
tipsList.3: Room Types: Assigning the correct room type (e.g., "Bedroom") ensures the AI stages it with the right furniture (beds vs sofas).
